caseNameFull: Christopher Hayden, et ux. v. Anthony E. D'Amico

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma paup-*475eris denied. Petitioner is allowed until December 20, 2010, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
